The logic followed here is:

**Position value of first word × 2 = Position value of second word**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/166c694277827b586436d1365ca6452a7944949b54207c8f63cdc37040b0f12a.png] 

**Here__,__** **Position value** of N is **14** . So 14 × 2 = 28 = **26 + 2 **

26 is position value of Z and** __alphabet series end with Z. Then it start from A. As 2 is position value of B__. So, N code as B.**

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ead1ba0b2000c29b111a3e575cea481b2e764b5ad314099ab60fc0d8ea816a6.png] 

Here__,__ Position value of T is **20** . So 20 × 2 = 40 = 26 + 14.

__Alphabet series end with Z(26). Then it start from A. As 14 is position value of N__. So, T code as N.

Hence, the correct answer is **"NPRNP'.**
